The canonical face model and MediaPipe HairSegmenter are by Google and the MediaPipe authors. https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
The photo recognizer bundles TensorFlow.js 4.22.0 and TensorFlow.js MediaPipe face detection and landmark models. https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models
HairSegmenter float32 v1 uses the original model weights with tensor layouts converted for TensorFlow.js WASM.
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/image_segmenter/hair_segmenter/float32/1/hair_segmenter.tflite
